name: Semax
summary: Semax is a synthetic heptapeptide analogue of ACTH(4-10) with the sequence Met-Glu-His-Phe-Pro-Gly-Pro. Papers describe nootropic and neuroprotective effects, often after nasal administration. Small human studies, mainly from Russian groups, have examined cognition in volunteers and patients with acute ischaemic stroke or optic nerve disease. Russian clinical use is not a SAHPRA registration.

research_uses.use: Memory, attention, and other cognitive measures in animals and in small human volunteer studies

sources.title: A nootropic adrenocorticotropin analog 4-10-semax (15 years experience in its design and study)
sources.quote: this peptide is capable to stimulate operative memory and attention, to increase resistance to hypoxia and to improve brain circulation in experimental animals and human beings over prolonged period (20-24 h after intranasal administration in doses 0.015-0.050 mg/kg). Semax significantly improves memory and attention in healthy men under extreme conditions of activities.

sources.title: Semax, an analog of ACTH(4-10) with cognitive effects, regulates BDNF and trkB expression in the rat hippocampus
sources.quote: The heptapeptide Semax (Met-Glu-His-Phe-Pro-Gly-Pro) is an analog of the adrenocorticotropin fragment (4-10) which after intranasal application has profound effects on learning and exerts marked neuroprotective activities.

research_uses.use: Neuroprotection after cerebral ischaemia, including a small Russian clinical study in acute hemispheric ischaemic stroke and later rodent tMCAO work

sources.title: Effectiveness of semax in acute period of hemispheric ischemic stroke (a clinical and electrophysiological study)
sources.quote: Efficiency of Semax (synthetic derivative of ACTH-4-10) was studied in 30 patients in acute period of hemispherical ischemic stroke. Control group consisted of 80 patients with the strokes analogous in severity and location of the damages and which were treated by conventional therapy.

sources.title: Novel Insights into the Protective Properties of ACTH(4-7)PGP (Semax) Peptide at the Transcriptome Level Following Cerebral Ischaemia-Reperfusion in Rats
sources.quote: The synthetic melanocortin derivative, ACTH (4-7) PGP (Semax), has been used successfully in the treatment of patients with severe impairment of cerebral blood circulation.

research_uses.use: Optic nerve disease in a Russian clinical trial using nasal drops, alongside other routes in comparison groups

sources.title: Evaluation of therapeutic effect of new Russian drug semax in optic nerve disease
sources.quote: Semax is a synthetic analog of adrenocorticotropic hormone 4-10 with a pronounced nootropic effect. It was used in the treatment of vascular, toxic allergic, and inflammatory diseases of the optic nerve and partial atrophy of the optic nerve in parallel with basic neurotrophic and antiinflammatory therapy.

research_uses.use: Modulation of BDNF and monoamine systems in rodent brain after Semax

sources.title: Semax, an analogue of adrenocorticotropin (4-10), binds specifically and increases levels of brain-derived neurotrophic factor protein in rat basal forebrain
sources.quote: The heptapeptide Semax (Met-Glu-His-Phe-Pro-Gly-Pro) is an analogue of the N-terminal fragment (4-10) of adrenocorticotropic hormone which, after intranasal application, has profound effects on learning and memory formation in rodents and humans, and also exerts marked neuroprotective effects.

sources.title: Semax, an ACTH(4-10) analogue with nootropic properties, activates dopaminergic and serotoninergic brain systems in rodents
sources.quote: Corticotrophin (ACTH) and its analogues, particularly Semax (Met-Glu-His-Phe-Pro-Gly-Pro), demonstrate nootropic activity.

reported_protocols.context: Commonly reported research protocol from Ashmarin et al. 1997, covering experimental animals and humans. This is a published amount, not an instruction to use Semax.

sahpra.notes: SAHPRA names Semax among examples of illegally marketed unregistered peptides. Papers and encyclopedias describe Russian clinical use of a nasal ACTH(4-10) analogue. A foreign registered-medicine status is not a SAHPRA registration. This is not legal advice.

sources.title: SAHPRA peptide products public information
sources.quote: Illegally marketed peptides include: BPC-157, TB-500, Melanotan II, CJC-1295, Ipamorelin, PT-141, AOD-9604, Selank, and Semax.

wada.notes: The official 2026 WADA Prohibited List does not name Semax. It is not in the S0 examples (BPC-157, DNP, and others) and is not under S2.3 (thymosin-β4 and derivatives e.g. TB-500). This catalog does not assign a WADA class. This is not anti-doping advice.
